Manual C1-C11 verification: C1(no full-sample stats)=PASS, C2(DD brake uses dd_lag=c(0,dd_pct[-n_f]) 1-day lag)=PASS, C3(no same-period aggregate)=PASS, C4(no financial statement used)=PASS, C5(DD overlay t-1)=PASS, C6(survivorship handled by RAWDATA)=PASS, C7(patterns clean)=PASS, C8(no FM weight)=PASS, C9(DD brake lagged)=PASS, C10(AvgTV20 shift(1L) lagged)=PASS, C11(no FRED data)=PASS, C13(Z_Score_Aligned)=PASS, C15(Arrow bulk load)=PASS. gate1.name: Implementation
gate1.details: N=30, commission=15bps, LIQ>=2e8, buffer_zone(50/25). DD parameters fixed (7/22/0.30) — not data-mined. Turnover=281% (<600%). Pure factor EW baseline with post-hoc DD overlay.

gate2.name: Robustness
gate2.details: OOS retention=0.834 (good). Rolling3Y_Pos=59.4% (marginal). Stress=3/3 outperform (excellent). BUT: DD 7/22 degraded SR from 0.645->0.272 (58% loss). Alpha trend ratio 1.38 (recent improving). The DD brake is excessively aggressive — cutting exposure too early (7% start) and too deep (min 30% exposure at 22% DD), destroying return while MDD only improved 50.9%->41.3%.

gate3.name: Performance
gate3.details: SR 0.272 (FAIL, target 0.8+). CAGR 3.86% (FAIL, target 16%). MDD 41.32% (FAIL, target <25%). IR -0.378 (negative — BM underperform). Calmar 0.093. BM_Corr 0.769. The DD brake converted a mediocre-but-positive-alpha strategy into a near-cash position during drawdowns, killing compounding.

gate4.name: Statistical
gate4.details: FMB Score lambda t=1.88 (not significant at 5%). DSR not available. Parent strategy FMB also marginal. No FF5 alpha test for S5 variant. Recent 3Y SR=0.374 shows weak recent performance.

gate5.name: Diversification
gate5.details: No Grade A composite cache available for correlation check. BM_Corr=0.769 indicates moderate beta exposure remains. Strategy offers no meaningful alpha contribution at current performance level.

reasons: DD 7/22 brake destroyed alpha: SR 0.645 -> 0.272 (58% degradation)
CAGR 3.86% — barely above risk-free, far below 16% target
MDD 41.3% still exceeds 25% target despite aggressive DD brake
FMB Score t=1.88 not statistically significant
DD calibration (7/22) too aggressive — starts cutting at only 7% DD

dd_calibration_analysis.diagnosis: DD 7/22 trades 58% of SR for only 19% MDD reduction. Catastrophic risk-return tradeoff. DD_START=7% triggers far too early — normal market corrections activate the brake and destroy compounding. Wider parameters (e.g., DD 15/30) or abandoning DD overlay recommended.

strengths: Stress outperformance 3/3 (DD brake helps in crises)
weaknesses: DD 7/22 too aggressive — 58% SR destruction for 19% MDD improvement
Parent strategy (pure factor) already weak (SR 0.645, MDD 50.9%)
Cokurtosis + Crowd Diversity as gate-only lacks standalone alpha (FMB t=1.88)
